note: Eight interleaved pairs on one host, alternating which runtime ran first. The parent opens a new leader connection for fetch. The candidate reuses the bootstrap connection when that socket is already the leader and already negotiated Fetch. Every run verified 20,000 records and validation_failures stayed 0. Before median 470,622.14 records/s, after median 548,446.79. Paired mean ratio 1.176, bootstrap 95% CI 1.152 to 1.205. Zero of eight pairs were slower. Client CPU-nanoseconds per record medians were 1,838.98 before and 1,783.07 after. Not a fetch comparison against other clients and not a fastest-client result.
host: Intel Xeon, 4 logical cores at 2400 MHz, Linux 6.12.94+, rustc 1.99.0, release
